stock.description: Jinhai Medical Technology Ltd. specializes in offering workforce solutions and a range of complementary support services. Catering primarily to building and construction contractors, their comprehensive service portfolio encompasses dormitory management, warehousing, cleaning operations, and building maintenance. Established in 2006, the firm maintains its corporate headquarters in China.
